commands.summary: Plan and execute the create or update segment reverse-ETL action
examples: pm smaily create or update segment apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: external mutation; creates a new segment or, when id is set, overwrites an existing segment's filter definition on the connected Smaily account; approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
commands.notes: named_dependency=engine.reverse_etl_scalar_flag_contract: the reverse-ETL command surface cannot faithfully expose this action's required object or array record fields as scalar flags

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create or update subscriber reverse-ETL action
examples: pm smaily create or update subscriber apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: external mutation; creates or updates a subscriber (matched by email) on the connected Smaily account; does not trigger automation workflows; approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the launch ab test reverse-ETL action
examples: pm smaily launch ab test apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: external mutation; creates and, unless save_as_draft is set, immediately launches a real A/B test campaign send to a percentage of a real subscriber list, with the winning variant auto-sent to the remainder at win_at; approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
commands.notes: named_dependency=engine.reverse_etl_scalar_flag_contract: the reverse-ETL command surface cannot faithfully expose this action's required object or array record fields as scalar flags

commands.summary: Plan and execute the send message reverse-ETL action
examples: pm smaily send message apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: external mutation; sends a real, individually-templated outbound email to real recipients using an automation workflow's template (without triggering the workflow itself); approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

examples: pm smaily subscribers list --json
pm smaily templates list --json

commands.summary: Plan and execute the trigger automation workflow reverse-ETL action
examples: pm smaily trigger automation workflow apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: external mutation; opts in subscribers and triggers a 'form submitted' automation workflow for them, updating subscriber data before any scheduled messages send; approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
commands.notes: named_dependency=engine.reverse_etl_scalar_flag_contract: the reverse-ETL command surface cannot faithfully expose this action's required object or array record fields as scalar flags

commands.summary: Plan and execute the unsubscribe recipient reverse-ETL action
examples: pm smaily unsubscribe recipient apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: external mutation; unsubscribes a recipient from a specific campaign (reflected in that campaign's statistics); approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
